results.overview: When Alex enters the basement, he discovers a grotesque ritual: a monstrous plant feeding on his father’s blood.

results.title: Terra del Sole
results.overview: In a small Renaissance village called “Terra del Sole,” a group of people awaits the arrival of an important event.

results.title: Bodies Under The Bridge
results.overview: Three high school mean girls bully their friend Adeline, but they don't realize what's coming for them.... or who....

results.title: ephemeral
results.overview: Ivy wants to avoid speaking about a traumatic situation with her mother, so she forces herself into a simulated reality that takes place in her own mind. Here she is met with her supposed paradise, but that doesn’t last long, because her trauma is so deeply rooted that it begins to seep through the simulation. She faces several manifestations of her inner thoughts in the form of real, tangible people who convince her that she is better off here, but she can’t help but feel as though her paradise has turned into something that is worse than the feelings she is trying to escape.

results.title: This Is an Autopsy
results.overview: A clinical gaze inspects a liminal place beyond space and time, where living and dead bodies coexist. As they resist collapse, the unidentified shapes remain suspended in darkness.

results.title: Vulnus
results.overview: After shaking off a fall, a skater with an injured arm passes by a figure whose gaze penetrates the wound.

results.title: Half a Decade of Projecting
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at going to the movies, from the projection booth.

results.title: Cold Call
results.overview: An extremely dedicated office worker begins to question her workplace’s mission of scamming strangers in order to return to their home planet. An eccentric and creative take on the absurdities of office culture and conspiracy theories, this dark comedy is utterly singular.

results.title: Skin of Olives
results.overview: A man who was adopted as a child, searches for his birth mother, only to uncover a truth that threatens to disrupt the very family he hoped to belong to.

results.title: Closed Mouths
results.overview: Stuck in a loop regarding his career, financial well-being, and ability to reach life’s milestones, an aspiring screenwriter is forced to confront the realities of choosing his passion over practicalities. A tale as old as time for creative workers, this film ponders the choices we make for ourselves and others.

results.title: Structure
results.overview: Through the eyes of a parking ticket machine, we experience the everyday realities of a city lobby: angry passersby, playful children, graffiti taggers, bickering couples, and drunken antics. Dissatisfied with its disrespectful patrons and constant view of the mundane, an act of rebellion sends the machine to uncharted territory.

results.title: Gill
results.overview: Days blur together for a maternity ward nurse who prays that a previous abortion was successful and that her late period will arrive in due time. Set among scenes of medical expertise, electricity blackouts, and camaraderie, this film feels lived-in, reminding us that life continues apace despite individual crises.

results.title: Folded Stories
results.overview: “It’s more than just clothes.” In this spoken-word film, fashion becomes the story, exploring the identities and memories woven into every thread.

results.title: Leptocephalus
results.overview: When a bite from an endangered eel starts replacing an unsuspecting scientist’s skin with salt, the scientist must give in to the unstoppable force of transformation. With a muted, earthy color palette, this hopeful short finds peace in the often painful process of becoming something, or someone, new.

results.title: the thought of the innermost being
results.original_title: the thought of the innermost being
results.overview: A workplace missive flows into dreamlike self-reflection, permeating hypnotic images of labour at a London fishmonger. Thoughts drift with repetition.

results.title: Wales Visitation
results.overview: Part travelogue, part performative intervention into myth making around place and persona. Retraces and communes with Allen Ginsberg’s Wales trip.

results.title: O River, We Forced You to Chew Up Their Crops
results.original_title: O River, We Forced You to Chew Up Their Crops
results.overview: Three intergenerational fables rooted in Nubian cosmologies confront the erasures wrought by the Aswan High Dam, tracing the rupture between people, the Nile and ancestral knowledge passed down through stories.

results.title: The Centre Cannot Hold
results.overview: Through speculative poetic narrative and tactile 16mm imagery, Corsica’s serene landscape gradually uncovers the island’s complex histories of belonging.
